about: the recount zone beside p for every record of D3's levels with p above 0 (brief D3 step 4; model section 3; MATH 5.10): each race whose zone, at any of the three rates, is at or above a third of the forecast's spread in votes, with the zone, the ratio and MATH 5.10's gain over p at each. p is unchanged everywhere (the orchestrator, 2026-11-13 10:12). Built by pipeline/local_recount.py; method in data/local/REPORT.md section 38.

rule.zone_votes: rate x n, n the count p is computed at (p.n) [inferred]
rule.gross: "The paper measures a candidate's change within one town, as a share of that candidate's votes, and you apply it to a race's whole count. Changes may add or cancel across towns and candidates, so the zone you build is a gross figure, as §3 treats Minnesota's 2,170." (the orchestrator, 2026-11-13 10:06)
rule.near: zone at or above a third of n x sd (model section 3: "At a zone a third the size of the spread, p is still 96% of its value"; the orchestrator, 10:12, 2)

sd_from.device: the like-race routes: the normal device of pipeline/local.py _p_like, "sd = 1.0 / (math.sqrt(2 * math.pi) * f)", centred at 1/2 (a measure's threshold), f = p.f_half (p.f_t)

rule.gain_over_p: MATH 5.10's smoothed gain over the sharp p, its continuous form; MATH 5.10's table reproduced within 0.002 (mu 0.50 and 0.52; w 10, 100, 1,000, 3,000, 10,000 votes)
rule.notes: each record near at 0.87% carries a note (the orchestrator, 10:12, 3); the others are listed here only

0.87%.what: the zone: hand counts without Bradford, the authors' baseline (Table 2, p. 5)

1.06%.what: the check: the upper end of that row's 95% interval (Table 2, p. 5)

2.49%.what: the sensitivity: hand counts with Bradford in (Table 2, p. 5)
